channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap with nine road widening projects unfunded
item.description: Martin County will need approximately $2.8 billion for transportation improvements over the next 20 years but only $701 million is currently available, leaving nine identified road widening projects without funding.

item.title: Palm Beach County commissioners deny private Christian school proposal in Jupiter Farms
item.description: Palm Beach County commissioners voted Tuesday to deny a controversial proposal to build a large private Christian school in Jupiter Farms after hours of emotional public debate over traffic, growth and the future of the community's rural character. item.title: Florida gas prices jump about 20 cents a gallon amid Strait of Hormuz military tensions
item.description: Florida gas prices rose about 20 cents a gallon Tuesday, catching many drivers off guard as military activity in the Strait of Hormuz pushed oil and wholesale gasoline prices higher.

item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council votes to rezone lot behind couple's home from residential to commercial
item.description: A Port St. Lucie couple is searching for answers after the city council voted unanimously to rezone the lot behind their home from residential to commercial, despite their months-long opposition.

item.title: Hobe Sound couple seeks community support as husband battles head and neck cancer
item.description: Dave and Faren Motz of Hobe Sound are asking for community support as they navigate a cancer diagnosis that has cost the couple nearly $20,000 out of pocket.

item.title: Fort Pierce neighbors pack planning meeting over Causeway Cove high-rise development proposal
item.description: The Fort Pierce Planning Board reviewed the Causeway Cove development project on Monday as neighbors packed the chamber. item.title: Atlanta increases security for England-Argentina World Cup semifinal Wednesday
item.description: Security and police presence will be increased for Wednesday's England-Argentina World Cup semifinal match in Atlanta after videos showed fans clashing in Miami.

item.title: Spain advances to World Cup final with 2-0 win over France
item.description: Mikel Oyarzabal scored from the penalty spot after a play by teenager Lamine Yamal, and Pedro Porro added another goal as Spain advanced to its first World Cup .

item.title: Police investigate death of South Africa World Cup player Jayden Adams in Cape Town
item.description: Police are investigating the death of 25-year-old South Africa World Cup soccer player Jayden Adams after his body was discovered Saturday at a property in Cape Town.

item.title: Jannik Sinner wins second consecutive Wimbledon title with victory over Alexander Zverev
item.description: Top-ranked Jannik Sinner beat Alexander Zverev 6-7, 7-6, 6-3, 6-4 on Sunday for his second consecutive title at the All England Club and fifth Grand Slam title.

item.title: World Cup final four features top-ranked teams after weekend quarterfinals
item.description: England and Argentina advanced to the semifinals after quarterfinal victories over Norway and Switzerland, joining Spain and France in the final four.

item.title: Man Killed Fleeing ICE Agents on Florida Highway as Agency Faces Scrutiny Over Fatal Encounters
item.description: A 28-year-old man died Tuesday after he was struck by a semi trailer truck while fleeing from U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents on State Road 16 near a gas station in Florida. item.description:

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
